title: validate_sha256_format returns InvalidSession for SHA-256 format errors
description: validate_sha256_format() returns ClientError::InvalidSession when the SHA-256 string is not 64 hex chars. InvalidSession is documented as 'Session document missing a required field'. Two callers: (1) download_blob with caller-supplied expected_sha256 — wrong format is an InvalidArgument (caller bug). (2) upload_blob with server-returned sha256 — wrong format is a Parse or InvalidSession-ish server error. The function uses one error variant for two semantically distinct situations, and that variant is wrong for at least one of them.
notes: Fix: (a) split into two call sites with appropriate errors, or (b) add a new ClientError variant for integrity check failures that covers format errors too, or (c) use InvalidArgument for caller path and Parse for server path.
